title: From contributing on Stack Overflow to joining the Firebase Team #MeetFirebase
description: In this episode of #MeetFirebase, Developer Advocate Doug Stevenson sits down with Firebase Engineer, Frank Van Puffelen. Learn how Puf went from answering questions on Stack Overflow to becoming a Google Firebase Engineer. If you want to learn more about developers & their passions outside of technology, then stay tuned for more #MeetFirebase!  Zero to App: Develop with Firebase → https://goo.gl/2mHyb9 Stack Overflow → https://goo.gl/vF4AsX  Watch more #MeetFirebase videos → https://goo.gl/DlBrhL Subscribe to the Firebase Channel → https://goo.gl/9giPHG
